name: Iron Fist
description: Close the fist on a hardened resolve and throw it as a blow that has been tempered in the mind first.

name: Iron Guard
description: Harden the forearms with a tempered will until a blow rings on them as on a bar of iron.

name: Iron Stride
description: Stride forward on a tempered will with the legs working as one unyielding hinge.

name: Tempered Nerve
description: Pass a tempered calm into an ally's hands so that the grip stops shaking before the next blow.

name: Hammered Will
description: Hammer the opponent with a tempered blow that lands and drives their qi flat beneath it.

name: Tempered Guard
description: Hold a shell of tempered will round the body that gets harder with each blow that strikes it.

name: Doubt Quenched
description: Quench the creeping doubt that a hostile will has laid in an ally's mind until the resolve burns clear.

name: Anvil Blow
description: Bring the tempered resolve down in one great blow like a hammer on an anvil and flatten the guard beneath.

name: Forged Aegis
description: Forge a broad aegis of will over the user and the nearest ally and harden the resolve of both under it.

name: Willed Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the whole will-field in behind it so the blow lands heavier than the arm.

name: Drawn Veil
description: Draw the will-field in against the skin as a thin veil that dulls the force of a blow.

name: Willed Drift
description: Let the will-field carry the body forward in a long low drift without a visible push of the feet.

name: Mind Touch
description: Spread the will-field outward and feel each mind that enters its edge as a small pressure.

name: Lent Steadiness
description: Let an ally stand inside the will-field and borrow its steadiness for as long as it is held.

name: Pressing Will
description: Raise the will-field until it presses on every opponent within it and slows their qi and their limbs.

name: Will Shove
description: Shove the will-field outward in a single pulse that pushes back everyone close to the user.

name: Fear Cleansing
description: Sweep the will-field through allies and wash out any fear or foreign command that clings to their minds.

name: Gathered Crush
description: Gather the will-field to a point and let it fall on every foe near so they are struck and held down.

name: Standing Ward
description: Lock the will-field into a standing ward over every ally within it so that blows weaken as they enter.

name: Decree Fist
description: Speak a short decree under the breath and throw a fist that carries the full authority of the word.

name: Decree Ward
description: Decree that no harm will pass and set a film of will in front of the user to enforce it.

name: Decree Stride
description: Decree the far mark near and cover the distance in one decided stride.

name: Decree Voice
description: Pronounce a decree of strength over an ally and let the weight of the word lift their effort.

name: Binding Decree
description: Decree that the opponent shall not move and let the will close round their limbs until the word is lifted.

name: Decree Rebuke
description: Rebuke an attack with a decree that turns it aside and presses the attacker's qi down.

name: Decree Crash
description: Pronounce a heavy decree and drive it into the opponent as a blow that crashes through guard and qi alike.

name: Recalling Decree
description: Decree a person whose breath has just stopped to return and hold the will on them until the heart restarts.

name: Azure Fist
description: Throw a fist with a clear blue-tinged will behind it that lands as plainly as a sworn word.

name: Cerulean Shell
description: Hold the guard in the posture of the sworn and let a pale blue shell of will form over the arms.

name: Azure Stride
description: Stride out with the chin high and the vow in mind so the body follows it without hesitation.

name: Azure Calm
description: Share a pale blue calm with the nearest ally until their breath slows and their sight clears.

name: Azure Eye
description: Look out with a clear unclouded will and feel which nearby minds are moved by fear or malice.

name: Azure Spur
description: Speak the vow aloud beside a tired ally and spur them forward on the strength of it.

name: Azure Binding
description: Bind the opponent's limbs with a vow spoken in a clear voice that they cannot shake off.

name: Azure Rebuke
description: Strike a foe who has broken a vow and press their qi under the weight of the broken word.

name: Azure Clearing
description: Clear the fog of dread or enchantment from an ally's mind with a vow held steadily until it lifts.

name: Azure Decree
description: Send the full vow forward as a narrow lance of will that passes through guard and flesh to the mind behind.

name: Azure Pledge
description: Pledge to guard the nearby allies and let a clear shell of will form over each and steady their blows.

name: Unbent Palm
description: Keep the head up and the wrist straight and drive a palm forward that does not yield at the end.

name: Unbent Guard
description: Meet the blow with the brow raised and the spine straight so the force breaks on the unbowed frame.

name: Unbent Stride
description: Walk straight at the opponent without a swerve and without lowering the eyes.

name: Unbent Voice
description: Say one level word to an ally and stiffen the spine of every fighter who hears it.

name: Unbent Hold
description: Hold the unbowed posture while a dense shell of will takes every blow without a bend.

name: Unbent Press
description: Press on the opponent's mind with the weight of the unbowed head until their qi sinks.

name: Unbent Purge
description: Straighten a cringing ally by driving a firm will through the fear or taint that bends them.

name: Unbent Verdict
description: Hand down a blow that lands as a verdict and presses the opponent's qi flat beneath the sentence.

name: Unbent Rebuff
description: Take each crushing pressure on the unbowed brow and send it back along the line it came with equal weight.

name: Lofty Palm
description: Bring a palm down from above the shoulder with the intent held high and clear.

name: Lofty Guard
description: Raise the guard with a clear high will and let the shell form over the head and shoulders first.

name: Lofty Stride
description: Take a light high stride as though the body were held up by the intent above it.

name: Lofty Sight
description: Lift the intent above the field and feel from it where every nearby mind is moving.

name: Lofty Calm
description: Let a high clear calm settle over an ally and lift their mind above the noise of the fight.

name: Lofty Aim
description: Loose a bolt of will from a high steady aim that drops onto the target without a waver.

name: Lofty Command
description: Issue a command from on high that rattles the foe's footing and strike while the stance is broken.

name: Lofty Lend
description: Lend a measure of high clear will to every ally nearby so their qi runs steadier and their aim true.

name: Lofty Purge
description: Let the clear high will wash through an ally and take away fear or compulsion laid by another.

name: Lofty Hold
description: Hold a high steady will over the user and let the shell shed blows as a roof sheds hail.

name: Descending Will
description: Lower the whole high intent onto the foes below in a single descent that strikes and holds them down.

name: Lifted Breath
description: Draw a stopped breath back into a person who has just fallen by lifting the will into their chest.

name: Gust Fist
description: Throw a fist with the sudden push of a gust behind it and a will that does not bend.

name: Gust Guard
description: Lean into a blow like a body leaning into wind and let the will hold the lean.

name: Gust Step
description: Spring forward on a short hard gust of will that leaves the heels barely touching the ground.

name: Gust Calm
description: Breathe out a steady will like the lull between gusts and let it settle the nearest ally.

name: Gust Listen
description: Turn the face to the wind of a crowd and read from it the mood of those who stand in it.

name: Gale Press
description: Press into the opponent with the weight of a rising gale until the blow lands and the qi sinks.

name: Sliding Ward
description: Turn each blow aside on a wind of will so that the force slides away to either hand.

name: Gale Clearing
description: Blow a clean will through an ally's mind like wind through a fog and carry off the dread in it.

name: Gale Hammer
description: Drive all the weight of a storm wind and a fixed will into one blow that lifts the foe from the feet.

name: Gale Rally
description: Rally the nearby allies on a hard wind of will that braces each of them against the blows.

name: Bare Fist
description: Throw a plain fist with no feint and let the open will behind it carry the strike home.

name: Bare Stance
description: Stand in plain sight with the arms low and let a film of will take the blow without a flinch.

name: Bare Step
description: Cross open ground in a few plain strides with no cover and no sound.

name: Bare Voice
description: Speak plainly to a fearful ally and let the honest will in the words straighten their back.

name: Open Order
description: Give an open order that no one can ignore and strike the opponent as their body half obeys.

name: Frank Ward
description: Hold an open ward of will that shields the user and lets the nearest ally draw courage from it.

name: Open Decree
description: Proclaim an open decree over the field so every foe near is pressed down by the weight of it.

name: Unlocked Mind
description: Break the binding that a hostile will has set on an ally's mind and free their thoughts to act.

name: Silent Fist
description: Throw a fist in total silence with the will gathered inside so the blow lands before it is seen.

name: Silent Guard
description: Take the blow without a sound or a shift and let the quiet will turn it dull.

name: Silent Step
description: Slip forward on a hush of will so that the body makes no stir in the air.

name: Silent Read
description: Stand silent and judge from the quiet of a stranger's mind whether it is set on harm.

name: Silent Spur
description: Press a wordless urging into an ally's mind that sets their feet moving at once.

name: Silent Weight
description: Rest an unspoken weight on the opponent's will until their qi runs slow and their limbs grow heavy.

name: Silent Break
description: Break the opponent's concentration with a blow that makes no sound and leaves the stance ruined.

name: Hushed Mind
description: Quiet the mind so completely that a hostile suggestion finds nothing to grip and falls away.

name: Final Verdict
description: Deliver the unspoken verdict as a narrow bolt of will that goes straight through armour and guard.

name: Verdict Lifted
description: Lift a sentence of fear or compulsion from an ally with a silent counter-verdict that dissolves it.
